solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8eea6c87abda2c7c451c4a938ad838f92ccd0a6ba26a5509238e97456de4c9d.png] ⇒ 6 × 6 = 36

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76109baac936b1bf4f596d8867d455e26c9462ba46a89da136243ada5879ad4.png] ⇒ 4 × 8 = 32

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9df5921b89243209ffd84e8e886c21f6422ef8c862a2ef8906f71e130c41f5e.png] ⇒ 7 × 2 = 14 ⇒ ? = 1 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
